description: This file declares the implementation of an IPC server for the Rialto project, including class definitions, method declarations, and internal data structures for managing IPC communication, clients, and sockets.

classes.name: ServerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IPC server instances.

classes.name: ServerImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the IPC server, managing client connections, message processing, and socket communication.

classes.name: ServerImpl::Socket
classes.description: Internal structure representing a listening socket and its associated data.

classes.name: ServerImpl::ClientDetails
classes.description: Internal structure holding details about connected clients.

methods.name: ServerFactory::create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the IPC server.

methods.name: ServerImpl::addSocket
methods.description: Adds a new socket for listening for client connections.

methods.name: ServerImpl::addClient
methods.description: Adds a new client based on a socket file descriptor.

methods.name: ServerImpl::fd
methods.description: Returns the server's main socket file descriptor.

methods.name: ServerImpl::wait
methods.description: Waits for events with a specified timeout.

methods.name: ServerImpl::sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event message to a specific client.

methods.name: ServerImpl::isClientConnected
methods.description: Checks if a client is currently connected.

methods.name: ServerImpl::disconnectClient
methods.description: Disconnects a client by its ID.

methods.name: ServerImpl::addClientSocket
methods.description: Creates and adds a client socket connection.

methods.name: ServerImpl::sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to a client.

methods.name: ServerImpl::sendErrorReply
methods.description: Sends an error reply to a client.

methods.name: ServerImpl::handleResponse
methods.description: Handles a response message from a client.

methods.name: ServerImpl::populateReply
methods.description: Prepares a reply message with protobuf response data.
